configuration.reason: Atomic independent result bundles and isolated deterministic retries

checks.name: Real CLI produces two complete results with different pinned sofa versions and explicit style/pose
Identical retry verifies existing bytes and is idempotent
Independent output root receives byte-identical portable results
JSON property ordering does not change deterministic result bytes
Changed input reports output-conflict and preserves every existing valid byte
One failed key leaves another success usable and can retry alone
Malformed per-item operations stay isolated and an explicit empty operation array is valid
Duplicate key rejects before any output directory is created
Windows-case duplicate key rejects before any output directory is created
Duplicate company identity rejects before any output directory is created
Directory traversal key rejects before any output directory is created
Windows device-name key rejects before any output directory is created
Tampered existing result is rejected without replacing the tampered bytes
Additional or missing bundle files are reported and never repaired over existing data
Existing file or junction cannot redirect result writes outside its result directory
An existing key lock reports busy without touching a result and retries after release
Concurrent real CLI publishers cannot mix or overwrite result bundles

limits: Actual local CLI, filesystem, source/GLB hashing, static placement and save pin round-trip only. No render/GPU or character navigation.
Same-key concurrent publishers honor exclusive lock files. An interrupted process may leave a lock which must be inspected before removal.
